policies.description: Blocked candidate may replace the incumbent with the lowest entry F10 score when candidate F10 score is strictly higher
R01 plus incumbent executable unrealized net return must be <= 0
R01 plus incumbent age must be >= 24 completed hours
R01 plus incumbent is nonpositive OR at least 24 completed hours old
R01 plus incumbent is nonpositive AND at least 24 completed hours old

replacement_execution: one-for-one only if hypothetical close frees enough canonical capital for MIN_NOTIONAL candidate entry
trigger: candidate blocked by MAX_POSITIONS or capital capacity only
